result.summary: The page is generally well laid out. One visible styling inconsistency affects readability in the promotional banner.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative translucent circles overlap the offer text area, reducing contrast and making parts of the subtitle, especially the minimum-order amount, harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Move or mask the decorative circles away from the text block, or lower their opacity so the headline and subtitle remain consistently legible.
